name: Shah Abdul Aziz Dehlawi
role: Hadith scholar and reformist legal thinker
contribution: He carried forward Shah Waliullah's scholarly legacy and shaped later Muslim legal and reformist debates under colonial rule.
context: As colonial power expanded in North India, his teaching became a bridge between Waliullahi scholarship and later reformist politics.
impact: He is useful for understanding the intellectual lineage behind nineteenth-century Muslim reform movements connected to Bengal.
highlight: A bridge from Waliullahi scholarship to later colonial-era reformist politics.
